hypothesis: 侧抓前确认目标并校准到已验证相对位姿可改善空抓；解除灶台接触时允许受筛查的同时开爪退离可解除入口死锁。
information_gain: 各一条真实连续序列，区分视觉辅助触发/实际夹持抬升/放架与同时开爪退离/实测开口/原归位；非相同随机流配对，不能分离多个干预的贡献。
success_criteria: 酒瓶第一次近距离闭爪提议先请求当前同步wrist+side图/编码器，视觉定位与投影几何关联通过、实际helper>0、confirmed且瓶子抬升；灶台开口受限时concurrent_open_retreat触发且actual open_and_retreat>0，之后实测标准开口并进入原home。每子任务只在实际VLA150/300检查，收尾后全部固定literal目标、无持物/手接触、原归位连续五个真实样本均通过；前碗成果保留。
failure_criteria: 应触发辅助却零动作、视觉关联拒绝或未发生同时开爪退离记触发链路未完成；执行后未夹到/目标不成立/退离或归位失败分别记效果失败。不得用归位替代目标物体成功，不放宽独立判据。
unknown_criteria: 视觉null/协议失败/初始化不明停止并保留错误；未启动不计VLA失败；只有视觉定位关联并非真机RGBD六维估计。

changed_factors.name: wine_pregrasp
changed_factors.before: native VLA only; close proposals misaligned
changed_factors.after: one dual-view visual association + current simulator geometry calibration, validated collision side-grasp helper then fresh-policy transport
changed_factors.reason: 修正抓取位姿，保留旧有效避碰与保护检查

changed_factors.name: turn_release
changed_factors.before: exact/near-full opening required before movement; one finger constrained
changed_factors.after: after failed opening allow only turn tasks to withdraw with explicit open command and measured/half/open CAD-screened path; exact original home gate remains
changed_factors.reason: 解除接触阻止张开、张开阻止退离的循环

changed_factors.name: action_accounting
changed_factors.before: job.steps counts only native VLA because no grasp helper
changed_factors.after: separate actual VLA/local grasp/finish; checks at actual VLA150/300; max300 VLA+200 grasp per subtask
changed_factors.reason: 辅助动作不能提前触发完成检查

fixed_factors.home: same home controller/streaming .01rad kp50 max360 five samples and exact-open entry
fixed_factors.checker: unchanged user-approved generic prompt; current wrist+side and synchronized encoder; 150/300 actual VLA actions
fixed_factors.environment: goal_table LIBERO goal8, Panda robosuite/MuJoCo seed0 init0 one reset per sequence
fixed_factors.policy: same pretrained SmolVLA weights, no training or environment reset between subtasks
fixed_factors.comparison: historical condition reference only; policy random stream not paired

scope.stop_rule: 各组合一次；先核对首碗通过才执行第二技能。首碗未通过停止其后续及另一组合。酒瓶预抓分支未触发/拒绝/失败不继续下游放架调参；首碗已通过时灶台为独立故障试点仍可继续。灶台同时开爪退离未执行则不单测归位。无现场重试，不微调、不扩大、不开子agent。

bowl_wine.request: 先将碗放到盘子上，再将酒瓶放到架子上。

bowl_stove.request: 先将碗放到盘子上，再打开灶台。
